title: Tabular Recipe
description: Turn any recipe into a compact process table — every ingredient and step at a glance.
summary: Turn any recipe into a compact process table — every ingredient and step at a glance.
offersHint: Turn any recipe into a compact process table — every ingredient and step at a glance. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.tabularrecipe.com/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key for recipe tools. Discovery and checkout tools work without it.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer API key for recipe tools. Discovery and checkout tools work without it.

toolsPreview.name: parse_recipe
toolsPreview.description: Parse recipe prose into a validated rgf/0-draft operation graph. Costs credits; fetch /v1/pricing first.

toolsPreview.name: render_recipe
toolsPreview.description: Validate and render an rgf/0-draft document as escaped, self-contained HTML. Free; spends no model credits.

toolsPreview.name: convert_recipe
toolsPreview.description: Parse recipe prose and render the validated graph as self-contained HTML in one call. Costs credits; fetch /v1/pricing first.

toolsPreview.name: list_styles
toolsPreview.description: List every available visual theme with its name, description, color swatches, and depth ramp. Free; spends no model credits.

toolsPreview.name: get_usage
toolsPreview.description: Read the calling key's current credit balance, today's allowance state, and aggregated usage. Free; use before a paid batch.

toolsPreview.name: create_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Create a Stripe-hosted checkout for a credit bundle without an API key. Returns a checkout URL and a secret one-time claim token. A human approves payment in Stripe; never expose or put the claim token in a URL.

toolsPreview.name: checkout_status
toolsPreview.description: Check whether an agent-created Stripe checkout is pending, paid, claimed, or expired. Requires its sessionId and secret claimToken, but no API key.

toolsPreview.name: claim_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Exchange a paid agent checkout plus its secret claim token for a new API key. The key is returned once; store it immediately.
